rules.statement: A plaintiff is entitled to use a common doorway and passage for the original intended purpose, even after selling their part of the property, if such use was implicit in the grant.
rules.supporting_quote: "The right to use the passage and the doorway for the purpose for which they had been originally intended and used all along is implicit in the grant to the plaintiff of the premises F with the common doorway. The defendant is therefore not entitled to block the passage by building on it."
